title: Jessica Simpson Brings a Little Texas to Her Walmart Fall Collection Amid Music Comeback
summary: Simpson's newest Walmart collection arrived Sept. 10, tapping into her Cali-boho style & Texas roots as she continues her music comeback and documentary rollout.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Jessica Simpson is having a busy fall. Between returning to music, preparing for a new Netflix documentary and expanding her Walmart fashion line, the singer has plenty keeping her in the spotlight.

Her latest Walmart collection arrived Sept. 10, bringing her signature Cali-boho aesthetic into fall with barn jackets, barrel-leg jeans, maxi dresses, ruffle tops and accessories. Prices start at $10+, making the new collection one of the more accessible ways to tap into Simpson’s recognizable style.

shop jESSICA siMPSON Walmart Fall 2026 Collection

The assortment draws heavily from the mix of bohemian fashion and Western influence that has become synonymous with Simpson. Flowing dresses and ruffled tops bring a romantic touch, while relaxed denim and barn jackets add structure and a nod to her Texas roots.

There’s also a subtle ’70s influence throughout the collection. Rather than leaning into head-to-toe retro dressing, Simpson’s latest Walmart pieces translate the era through wearable details: relaxed denim silhouettes, flowy dresses, feminine ruffles and easy layering pieces.

View this post on Instagram

That makes the collection particularly useful for the September transition. A maxi dress can still work during warmer days, while a barn jacket gives it a fall update. Barrel-leg jeans can be paired with a lightweight top now and a sweater later, making them the kind of staple that can stay in rotation throughout the season.

BEST FALL JACKET

Jessica Simpson Women's Barn Jacket

$49.50

Buy Now at walmart

Available in sizes XS to XL.

The barn jacket is one of fall’s standout layers, and Simpson’s $49.50 oversized version makes the trend feel distinctly her own with its Western-leaning aesthetic. It’s an especially good pick for those in-between September days when you need a jacket but aren’t ready for a heavier coat.

BEST BOHO DRESS

Jessica Simpson Women's Sienna Maxi Dress

$36.60

One of Walmart’s highly rated dresses is still available in sizes XS to M.

This maxi dress is the kind of throw-on-and-go style that still looks thoughtfully put together. It has a tiered silhouette, flutter sleeves, lace and bow details, plus an elastic waist for a little extra shape.

BEST AFFORDABLE DENIM

Jessica Simpson Women's and Women's Plus Daisy Fitted Flare Jeans

$17 $24.50 31% off

At an especially wallet-friendly price, these jeans come in four denim washes and three lengths, including short, regular and long.

These affordable Jessica Simpson flare jeans are fitted through the hips and thighs before kicking out into a classic flare, with stretch denim for comfort.

BEST ’70S-INSPIRED TOP

Jessica Simpson Women's Ella Ruffle Top

$28.50

It’s the same boho-inspired pattern as the previous dress, but in an easy-to-style top. It’s currently available in sizes XS to XL.

For a blouse that feels a little more special than the everyday basic, this Jessica Simpson top delivers with a ruffled peplum silhouette and feminine button details. The V-neck makes it easy to layer or wear on its own.

BEST STATEMENT ACCESSORY

Jessica Simpson Women's Roxie Shoulder Handbag

Leopard

$26

Available in leopard, black and olive colorways.

The butterfly dangle is what caught our eye on this $26 Jessica Simpson shoulder bag, which also has an adjustable strap and paisley lining.

BEST DENIM OVERALLS FOR FALL

Jessica Simpson Women's Overall Barrel Leg

$39.50

A highly-rated denim overall with a subtle barrel leg design.

For a one-and-done fall outfit, these $39.50 Jessica Simpson overalls make a strong case for the barrel-leg trend with an denim silhouette and adjustable straps.

BEST COZY CARDIGAN

Jessica Simpson Women's Savana Cardigan

$29.50

The style comes in sizes XS-XL and has a full button placket, long sleeves, and ribbed finishing throughout.

A floral print gives this cardigan more personality than your average button-front knit. It has a V-neckline, dropped shoulders and ribbed trim, with the classic button-front construction keeping the shape familiar.

BEST MID-RISE JEAN

Jessica Simpson Women's Cherry Barrel Jean

$34.50

Sizes range from 2-16, with belt loops, five-pocket styling, a button closure and zip fly.

This pair lands somewhere between a straight leg and a wide leg, thanks to its curved barrel shape. The jeans have a mid-rise waist, ankle-length cut, five pockets and a button-and-zip closure.

BEST PLUS-SIZE MINI DRESS

Jessica Simpson Women's Plus Calanthe Ruffle Mini Dress

$10.58

Available in 0X-4X, it has a mini-length hem, long sleeves, and elasticized cuffs.

The Calanthe has the kind of details that make a floral dress stand out. Along with its V-neckline and empire waist, it features long sleeves, elasticized cuffs, ruffle trim and a ruffled hem.

BEST FOR EARLY FALL

Jessica Simpson Women's Emmory Tiered Maxi Dress

$38.50

Only available in XS.

Boho-inspired style has long been part of Jessica Simpson’s style, and the Emmory Tiered Dress leans right into it. The flowy tiered skirt, puff sleeves and sweetheart neckline create a romantic silhouette that feels made for the start of fall.

The collection reflects Simpson’s evolution beyond music. She rose to fame as a pop singer in the late 1990s alongside Britney Spears, Christina Aguilera and Mandy Moore, with her 1999 single “I Wanna Love You Forever” peaking at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 . She later expanded into television, publishing and fashion, turning the Jessica Simpson name into a lifestyle brand spanning clothing, footwear and accessories. Her Walmart line, which launched in 2024, brings that aesthetic to shoppers at more accessible prices.

Now, music is once again part of the story. After a 15-year hiatus from releasing original music, Simpson returned with Nashville Canyon: Part 1 and Nashville Canyon: Part 2 . She is also the subject of a feature-length Netflix documentary exploring her life and career, with Joe Pearlman attached to direct.

For now, her latest Walmart collection gives fans something they can wear. From barrel-leg jeans and barn jackets to flowy dresses and ruffle tops, the fall 2026 lineup stays rooted in the California boho and Texas influences that have long defined her style.
